name: Monjistha [Rubia cordifolia]
indication_description: This is indicated in Dysmenorrhoea, Oligomenorrhea, Metritis, Edema.
pharmacology_description: Monjistha (Rubia cordifolia) has a marked effect on the female reproductive organs. It is useful in the treatment of various gynecological problems, like oligomenorrhea, irregular menstruation and dysmenorrhea. It stimulates and cleanses the uterus; so useful in postnatal ailments.
contraindications_description: Not to be used during pregnancy.
storage_conditions_description: Keep all medicines out of reach of children. Store in a cool and dry place, protected from light.
